Job description

Senior Android Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)

You will:

  • Develop and optimize Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions

  • Integrate data and functionality through API interfaces in mobile applications

  • Translate business requirements into technical requirements and propose your own solutions to problems

  • Apply LLMs and agentic development workflows to support the SDLC process

  • Follow Google's Android UI design principles, patterns and best practices

  • Participate in code reviews and work in an Agile environment

You bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Android development and Kotlin Multiplatform

  • Expert knowledge of Android SDK, different Android versions and device configurations

  • Experience with Android Architecture components, Jetpack libraries, MVVM and Clean Architecture

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose and Coroutines

  • Experience optimizing mobile apps in Java and Kotlin

  • Experience with Firebase configuration

  • Good knowledge of working with LLMs and agentic development

  • Familiarity with Git, JIRA, Confluence and code review processes

  • Good understanding of Agile methodologies

  • Attention to detail, a proactive approach and a strong focus on solution delivery

  • English at a professional level (minimum B2)
